The owner reports only the Language and Region values, or approves a tightly cropped screenshot containing only those values.
The discovery driver updates the authority and environment cell without retaining Apple ID, location, preferred-language history, or other settings.

affected_records: future Search rows whose behavior differs by entitlement
completed_independent_work: No in-app account, sign-in state, trial banner, paywall, or entitlement badge was visible on the empty Search root. The installed app identity and build are pinned.
fallback: Describe only the observed installed runtime and do not call it paid, Pro, trial, subscribed, or account-bound.

During Search reconnaissance, record any limit, paywall, restore-purchase control, or entitlement-dependent Search behavior if it becomes reachable.

Enter each approved Search path separately and record whether iOS prompts, allows, denies, or opens a picker.
Cancel before selecting unrelated content, restore each app-specific permission to its recorded starting state, and retain only synthetic evidence.
Update the relevant matrix cell and atomic rows independently for allow, deny, cancel, retry, and restoration.

field: standard iOS software-keyboard appearance and dismissal
affected_records: future keyboard visual and accessibility rows
completed_independent_work: Focus, Cancel, clear, hardware-key input, handwriting, radical, and input-mode accessory behavior were captured. Selecting keyboard mode hid the custom panel but did not expose a software keyboard in the mirrored runtime.
fallback: Treat typed-input behavior as observed but keep software-keyboard geometry, keys, input source, and dismissal unknown.

With only a synthetic query visible, capture appearance, input-source switching, dismissal, Return/Search, and focus restoration.

blocks_final_rows: Future standard software-keyboard visual and interaction rows

field: long Search-result list scrolling and terminal extent
owner: device owner or discovery driver with a working physical swipe authority
completed_independent_work: Long result classes were captured at the top, and visible rows were inventoried. The available scroll command did not move the mirrored list; a coordinate attempt activated an Additional Match and proved its Word Detail edge instead.
fallback: Do not claim terminal-row, pagination, lazy-load, or scroll-restoration behavior.
resume_procedure: Open the synthetic もんだい or think result set on the physical iPhone.
Swipe the results list to its terminal extent without selecting a row, capturing each newly revealed layout or control.
Return from one newly revealed result, record scroll-position restoration, and repeat until no new rows or controls appear.

field: Search offline, failure, and retry states
completed_independent_work: A deterministic no-match state and all required online fixture classes were captured. No distinct loading state persisted long enough to capture.
fallback: Keep offline, transport failure, stale data, and retry behavior unknown; do not equate the blank no-match state with a network error.
resume_procedure: Confirm a network-isolation method that will not strand iPhone Mirroring, or perform the probe directly on the physical iPhone.
Record the connected starting state, run one cached-looking and one uncached synthetic query, isolate network access, and repeat them.
Capture immediate and settled states, any error copy or retry control, restoration after reconnect, and whether earlier results persist.
Restore the recorded network state before ending the session.
